newsitem.title: USA: GE unit, Positron extend deal closing.
newsitem.headline: GE unit, Positron extend deal closing.

text.p: GE Medical Systems, a unit of General Electric Co, and Positron Corp said Thursday they have extended the closing of Positron's acquisition of GE Medical's Positron emission tomography (PET) assets to March 31.
All other terms of the acquisition agreement, which was announced in July, remain substantially unchanged, they said.
Positron chief executive Werner Haas said the extension will allow Positron additional time to complete regulatory requirements and finalize its financing pockage.

According to a previous announcement, Houston-based Positron would buy the medical scanner assets for $25 million plus 10 percent of Positron's outstanding common stock. GE Medical, based in Milwaukee, will also have a three-year option to buy an additional 15 percent of Positron common stocks.
